options.name: default
options.description: A boolean value indicating whether or not the VPC is the default network for the region. All applicable resources are placed into the default VPC network unless otherwise specified during their creation. The C(default) field cannot be unset from C(true). If you want to set a new default VPC network, update the C(default) field of another VPC network in the same region. The previous network's C(default) field will be set to C(false) when a new default VPC has been defined.

options.name: description
options.description: A free-form text field for describing the VPC's purpose. It may be a maximum of 255 characters.

options.name: ip_range
options.description: The requested range of IP addresses for the VPC in CIDR notation. Network ranges cannot overlap with other networks in the same account and must be in range of private addresses as defined in RFC1918. It may not be smaller than /24 nor larger than /16. If no IP range is specified, a /20 network range is generated that won't conflict with other VPC networks in your account.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the VPC. Must be unique and contain alphanumeric characters, dashes, and periods only.

options.name: oauth_token
options.description: DigitalOcean OAuth token. There are several other environment variables which can be used to provide this value. i.e., - C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN).

options.name: region
options.description: The slug identifier for the region where the VPC will be created.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the VPC should be present (created) or absent (deleted).

options.name: timeout
options.description: The timeout in seconds used for polling DigitalOcean's API.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If set to C(no), the SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only set to C(no) used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
